AGRICULTURE — TERMLY EXAM #9
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: AGRICULTURE
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Water always increases oxygen
   B. Water removes heat too quickly
   C. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely
   D. Petrol fires have no fuel

2. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Properties of soil? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Properties of soil.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Properties of soil.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Properties of soil.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Properties of soil.

3. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Land Preparation? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Land Preparation.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Land Preparation.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Land Preparation.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Land Preparation.

4. A compound differs from a mixture because: (1 mark)
   A. A compound can be separated by filtering only
   B. Mixtures cannot exist in Kenya
   C. A mixture always has a fixed melting point
   D. Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio

5. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Paper burning to ash
   B. Iron rusting
   C. Milk souring
   D. Ice melting to water

6. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Overgrazing continuously
   B. Removing all vegetation
   C. Burning crop residue every week
   D. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes

7. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Agricultural Land? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Agricultural Land.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Agricultural Land.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Agricultural Land.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Agricultural Land.

8. Which practice best shows correct science when studying General Crop Harvesting? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on General Crop Harvesting.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about General Crop Harvesting.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for General Crop Harvesting.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to General Crop Harvesting.

9. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Growing Selected Crops 1.6 Crop Protection: Weed control 1.7 General Crop Harves? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Growing Selected Crops 1.6 Crop Protection: Weed control 1.7 General Crop Harves.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Growing Selected Crops 1.6 Crop Protection: Weed control 1.7 General Crop Harves.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Growing Selected Crops 1.6 Crop Protection: Weed control 1.7 General Crop Harves.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Growing Selected Crops 1.6 Crop Protection: Weed control 1.7 General Crop Harves.

10. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Breeds of Livestock? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Breeds of Livestock.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Breeds of Livestock.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Breeds of Livestock.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Breeds of Livestock.

11. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Crop Protection: Weed control? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Crop Protection: Weed control.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Crop Protection: Weed control.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Crop Protection: Weed control.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Crop Protection: Weed control.

12. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Field Management Practices? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Field Management Practices.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Field Management Practices.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Field Management Practices.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Field Management Practices.

13. In a food chain, green plants are usually: (1 mark)
   A. Decomposers only
   B. Tertiary consumers
   C. Producers
   D. Primary consumers only

14. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Safe Handling of Animals? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Safe Handling of Animals.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Safe Handling of Animals.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Safe Handling of Animals.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Safe Handling of Animals.

15. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Growing Selected Crop? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Growing Selected Crop.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Growing Selected Crop.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Growing Selected Crop.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Growing Selected Crop.

16. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 50 °C
   B. 0 °C
   C. 100 °C
   D. 37 °C

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
